Tether-Backed Chilean Crypto Exchange Orionx Shuts Down After $7M+ Asset Shortfall

Chilean crypto exchange Orionx has begun a permanent shutdown after a forensic audit found that more than $7 million in customer assets had been transferred to wallets outside the company’s control. Withdrawals are suspended, and Orionx has filed criminal complaints against co-founders Roberto Zibert and Joaquín Díaz over alleged transfers of BTC, ETH, XRP and POL between 2018 and 2021; both deny wrongdoing.
